review_findings.finding: Missing freshness and session fields were accepted as authoritative idle/owned snapshots.
review_findings.implementation: ControlOperationPolicy requires control_fresh exactly true, control_unavailable_sources exactly [], a session object with boolean active/app_running and nonnegative integer count (not bool), and active/count consistency. Idle requires explicit inactive/count zero/app_running false and valid inactive lists. Close requires exactly one matching running app, app_running true, connected count equal to authoritative session count, and exact UUID when connected. No compatibility defaults remain. Vibepollo rejects unavailable/null source collections and missing appRunning/session count before declaring control_fresh.
review_findings.tests: Explicit authoritative envelopes in all positive fixtures; missing each required field, false/string freshness, unavailable source, malformed/missing/contradictory session, count bool, another running app and disconnected app tests. Isolated production PowerShell AST tests also cover Force cache bypass, backoff, missing source/count, null RTSP, singleton output.

review_findings.finding: Successful host reauthorization could be abandoned on cancellation/stale callback/failed local bind, especially target parent without an allowance.
review_findings.implementation: RetainedControlHandoff owns the post-ack sequence. The existing retained owner atomically checks and commits actor/generation with the exact captured NvConnection CAS; no split bindActor/bindControlGeneration remains on this path. Successful commit publishes the new intent binding before checking cancellation; cancellation retains a neutral stream under the new coherent ownership. Stale/failed/throwing post-ack paths invoke one exact compensation: captured child allowance end or existing HostSessionTermination with the acknowledged parent stream/app/generation and verified provider idle. Reusable obsolete local ownership is discarded only for the captured owner/session and old-or-acknowledged generation; newer generations and ongoing terminal ownership are preserved. A stale next-frame callback also compensates. Local disposal and host success are logged separately; unavailable host compensation is not reported as successful.
review_findings.tests: Deterministic handoff cancellation before callback and during publication, normal sequence, every post-ack callback exception, current=false, connection commit=false, newer parent generation; actual retained-owner atomic CAS, owner replacement, stale generation and TERMINATING protection; production Game wiring contract; Gateway/Bridge child cancellation and late parent full_quit against a newer retained generation.
